actions.command: /bin/zsh -c "cat tsconfig.json tsconfig.build.json pnpm-workspace.yaml package.json packages-private/tsconfig.json; rg -n 'ShallowRef|export \\*|\"(name|version|dependencies|devDependencies|optionalDependencies|peerDependencies|scripts)\"' packages/*/package.json packages-private/*/package.json packages/*/src/index.ts packages/vue/src/runtime.ts; ls node_modules/typescript; ls node_modules/.pnpm | head"

/bin/zsh -c "node --input-type=commonjs <<'NODE'
const ts=require('typescript'),path=require('path');for(const cfg of ['tsconfig.json','packages-private/tsconfig.json']){const p=ts.getParsedCommandLineOfConfigFile(path.resolve(cfg),{}, {...ts.sys,onUnRecoverableConfigFileDiagnostic:console.log});console.log(cfg,JSON.stringify({exclude:p.raw.exclude,options:p.options.paths,files:p.fileNames.filter(x=>x.includes('proxy'))}));}
NODE
rg -n 'ShallowRef|export \\*' packages/vue-compat/src/esm*; nl -ba packages/runtime-core/src/index.ts | sed -n '188,225p'; nl -ba packages/runtime-core/src/helpers/useTemplateRef.ts | head -25; nl -ba packages/runtime-core/src/customFormatter.ts | sed -n '182,200p'; cat packages-private/sfc-playground/src/vue-dev-proxy.ts; ls -l packages/runtime-core/node_modules/@vue packages-private/vite-debug/node_modules packages-private/sfc-playground/node_modules/vue packages/server-renderer/node_modules/vue"
